style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, deep rich colors, dark background with the main figure brightly lit, a faint washi-paper texture. Viking Age Scandinavian clothing.
avoid_en: any text, letters, numbers, logos, modern buildings or clothes, horned helmets, comic-book superhero costumes or capes, nudity, blood

thor.desc_en: Thor, the Norse god of thunder, a burly broad-chested man about 35 with a thick red beard and long red hair partly braided, fierce bright blue eyes, Viking Age clothing: a knee-length dark red wool tunic with woven trim, a thick leather belt with an iron buckle, gray wool trousers wrapped with leg bindings, leather shoes, iron gauntlets, and a heavy iron hammer with a short handle

cuts.image: 嵐の夜、赤いひげの雷の神が鉄の槌を振り上げ、怒った顔でこちらをにらむ上半身。その左後ろの空に、大きく明るい木星が浮かぶ。上下の4分の1は暗い空と暗い海だけ
cuts.image_en: A stormy night: the red-bearded thunder god raises his iron hammer and glares at the viewer with a furious face, upper body, lit by lightning. Behind him on the left, a huge glowing planet Jupiter with its banded stripes hangs in the dark sky. Both are drawn large at the vertical middle of the picture; the top quarter and the bottom quarter of the picture show only dark sky and dark sea with nothing in them.

cuts.image: 白い花嫁のヴェールをかぶった赤いひげの大男が、ヴェールの下からぎらりとこちらをにらみ、ひざの上の鉄の槌をつかむ上半身。暗い巨人の館、たき火の光。上下の4分の1は暗い壁と床だけ
cuts.image_en: A big red-bearded man wearing a white bridal veil glares fiercely at the viewer from under the veil and grips the iron hammer lying on his lap, upper body, in a dark giant's hall lit by firelight; a slightly comical but intense mood. He is drawn large at the vertical middle of the picture; the top quarter and the bottom quarter show only dark wall and dark floor with nothing in them.
